demo.title: send-stock.sh
demo.code:
HOST=https://basemate-imessage-production.up.railway.app

# Live list. Do not recite an old ticker list.
curl -s "$HOST/api/muse/stocks"

# Start a send. No API key. Money moves only when this user Apple Pays.
curl -s -X POST "$HOST/api/muse/sends" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "symbol": "AAPL",
    "usd": "5",
    "payer": { "name": "Alex", "phone": "+15551111111" },
    "recipient": { "name": "Sarah", "phone": "+15552222222" }
  }'

# Poll until sent or failed, then paste tellSender to the payer.
curl -s "$HOST/api/muse/sends/SEND_ID"

setup: No API key and no secrets. Do not ask the user for a URL or key.
GET /api/muse/stocks before naming what is available. Ten stocks: AAPL, AMZN, GOOGL, META, MSFT, MSTR, NVDA, SNDK, SPCX, TSLA.
Resolve the recipient from Muse Contacts to one E.164 number. Never invent a phone number.
POST /api/muse/sends, then paste sayThis and the payUrl. Money moves only when that user Apple Pays on Basemate.
Poll GET /api/muse/sends/{sendId} every second until sent or failed, then paste tellSender in the chat.
